title: 「Once 句：一旦……／……之後便……」
titleEn: Using once to show what happens after a stage is reached

source.file: Sentence Structure 116 -「Once 句：一旦……／……之後便……」.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

example: Once you understand the pattern, it becomes easier.
exampleZh: 一旦你明白這個規律，事情便會變得更容易。

examples.en: Once you understand the pattern, it becomes easier.
examples.zh: 一旦你明白這個規律，事情便會變得更容易。

rules.zh: Once 強調「先完成一件事，然後發生另一件事」 Once 通常帶有「到了某個階段之後」的意思。 車門打開是第一個事件；乘客進入是其後發生的事情。
rules.en: Once emphasizes that one event is completed or a stage is reached before the next event occurs. It often means ‘after a certain point has been reached’: the door opening is the first event, and the passengers entering is what happens afterwards.
examples: Once the door opens, the passengers can enter.

rules.zh: 表達將來時，once 子句通常不使用 will 在時間子句中，即使意思涉及將來，once 後通常使用現在式或現在完成式。
rules.en: For future meaning, do not normally use will in the once-clause. Even when the meaning concerns the future, use the present simple or present perfect after once.
examples: Once you finish the report, I will check it.
Once you have finished the report, I will check it.

rules.zh: Once 子句放在前面時，通常使用逗號 Once 子句放在後面時，通常不需要逗號。
rules.en: Use a comma after an initial once-clause; a final once-clause normally needs no comma.
examples: Once the rain stops, we can leave.
We can leave once the rain stops.

rules.zh: Once 可以配合不同時態 Present 現在： Future 將來： Past 過去： Past perfect 過去完成：
rules.en: Once can be used in present, future, past and past-perfect contexts.
examples: Once I understand a topic, I remember it more easily.
Once the shop opens, we will go inside.
Once the meeting ended, everyone went home.
Once the final guest had arrived, the host began the speech.

rules.zh: Once 與 When 的分別 When 是較廣泛和中性的時間連接詞，可以表示： ● 某件事發生的時候； ● 兩件事同時發生； ● 每逢某件事發生； ● 將來某個時間點。 Once 則更強調第一件事已經發生、完成，或到達某個階段，然後第二件事才發生。 這裏兩件事在同一段時間發生，不適合改用 once。 這裏強調先完成閱讀，然後才還書。 在部分將來句中，when 和 once 都可以使用，但 once 更突出「第一個階段完成後」的意思。
rules.en: Once emphasizes completion before a later event, unlike the broader and more neutral time linker when. When can mark the time of an event, simultaneous events, repeated occasions or a future time point. Once stresses that the first event has happened or been completed, or that a stage has been reached, before the second event occurs. It is therefore unsuitable when two events merely happen at the same time. In some future sentences either when or once is possible, but once highlights completion of the first stage.
examples: When I was reading, the phone rang.
Once I finished reading, I returned the book.

rules.zh: Once 與 If 的分別 If 表示一個未必會發生的條件。 Once 通常表示說話者預期或相信這件事會發生，只是不知道確實時間。 完成報告仍帶有不確定性。 說話者預期對方會完成報告，重點是完成之後要做甚麼。 簡單來說： ● When：當……的時候，屬中性時間關係。 ● If：如果……，事情可能發生，也可能不發生。 ● Once：一旦……／……之後，通常預期第一件事會發生，並強調其後的結果。
rules.en: Once normally presents an expected event, whereas if presents an uncertain condition. With if, the event may or may not happen; with once, the speaker expects it to happen but does not know exactly when, and the focus is on what follows. In short, when expresses a neutral time relationship, if presents a possible condition, and once presents an expected first event and emphasizes its subsequent result.
examples: When：當……的時候，屬中性時間關係。
If：如果……，事情可能發生，也可能不發生。
Once：一旦……／……之後，通常預期第一件事會發生，並強調其後的結果。
If you finish the report, send it to me.
Once you finish the report, send it to me.

benefits.zh: 讓事情的先後次序更清楚 這個句型能清楚說明哪一個動作先發生，以及其後會發生甚麼。
benefits.en: It makes the order of events clear. This structure clearly shows which action must happen first and what happens afterwards.

benefits.zh: 可以把兩個步驟合併成一句 你不需要使用「先……，然後……」寫成兩句，也可以運用 once 自然地連接兩個步驟。 第二句較緊密，而且能立即顯示兩件事的關係。
benefits.en: It can combine two steps in one sentence. Instead of writing two separate sentences with first and then, you can connect the steps naturally with once. The combined version is tighter and makes the relationship between the two events immediately clear.

benefits.zh: 表示完成一個階段後，另一件事才變得可行 讀者能立即明白使用機器之前必須完成甚麼。
benefits.en: It shows that something becomes possible after a stage is completed. The reader can immediately see what must be completed before the machine can be used.
examples: Once the safety check is complete, the machine can be used.

benefits.zh: 適合說明指示和計劃 你可以使用 once 說明工作流程、食譜、行程、課堂指示和其他有先後次序的安排。
benefits.en: It is useful for instructions and plans. You can use once to explain procedures, work arrangements, recipes, travel plans, classroom instructions and other arrangements with a clear sequence.

benefits.zh: 比 if 更能表達預期和確定性 當你預期第一件事將會發生時，once 能讓你集中說明其後的安排，而不是討論事情會否發生。
benefits.en: It can sound more certain than if. When you expect the first event to happen, once helps you focus on what should happen next rather than questioning whether the event will happen.
